high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner, taken 8 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The photo shows Kendall Jenner standing inside an elevator with wooden paneling on the walls and ceiling. She is taking a mirror selfie using her phone, which is held up to her face. Kendall is dressed in a stylish outfit that includes a long black coat, a sheer brown crop top, a matching brown skirt, and black wide-leg pants. She is also wearing black high-heeled shoes and sunglasses.
